suppressions.reason: CSA reports the reusable fixed-size nanobind array caster as moved-from at nb_array.h:34. Its from_python loop assigns every std::array element before extracting the completed value; the fixed-size array remains writable after the trivial element-wise move.

suppressions.remove_when: Remove when CSA no longer emits this exact cplusplus.Move diagnostic at nb_array.h:34 for the contact_binding.cpp matrix conversion, or nanobind stops reusing the fixed-size element caster.

suppressions.message: Out of bound access to memory after the end of the field 'ob_item'
suppressions.reason: CSA flags PyTuple_GET_ITEM at nb_types.h:1583 as an out-of-bound read of ob_item, which CPython declares as a one-element array while tuple objects are allocated with variably sized storage; the iterator only walks indices < PyTuple_GET_SIZE.
suppressions.reproducer: uv run python tools/native_checks.py --kind analyzer --build native/build; security.ArrayBound at nanobind/nb_types.h:1583 reached via tuple iteration in native/src/runtime/runtime_binding.cpp owned_copy
suppressions.remove_when: Remove when CSA stops reporting PyTuple_GET_ITEM's variably sized ob_item access as out-of-bounds at nb_types.h:1583, or nanobind's tuple iterator stops using NB_TUPLE_GET_ITEM.

suppressions.message: Method called on moved-from object of type 'std::vector'
suppressions.reason: CSA flags the field-catalog sort comparator at database_validate.cpp:143 because it models std::ranges::sort's internal element moves pessimistically: the comparator's reference parameters a/b appear potentially moved-from. A correct sort never invokes the comparator on moved-from elements; both arguments denote live rows of the 'declared' vector under permutation.
suppressions.reproducer: uv run python tools/native_checks.py --kind analyzer --build native/build; cplusplus.Move at native/src/recording/database_validate.cpp:143:79
suppressions.remove_when: Remove when CSA no longer reports a moved-from std::vector access inside the sort comparator in validate_declared_catalog.

suppressions.message: File position of the stream might be 'indeterminate' after a failed operation
suppressions.reason: CSA flags the RFC 4180 CSV reader's get/peek lambdas at plot.cpp:71-73 because fgetc/ungetc execute after an earlier fgetc may have returned EOF. The pattern is defined behavior: fgetc on a stream whose end-of-file indicator is set simply returns EOF again, and peek() only calls ungetc when fgetc returned a real character (c!=EOF guard), so no stream operation ever follows a failed operation with an indeterminate position.
suppressions.reproducer: uv run python tools/native_checks.py --kind analyzer --build native/build; unix.Stream at native/src/viz/plot.cpp:71:38, 73:39 and 73:70
suppressions.remove_when: Remove when CSA no longer emits unix.Stream diagnostics for the fgetc/ungetc calls in the plot.cpp CSV reader, or the reader stops using stream getc/ungetc primitives.

suppressions.message: Read function called when stream is in EOF state. Function has no effect
suppressions.reason: Companion unix.Stream diagnostic to the indeterminate-position finding in the same file: the CSV reader's loop intentionally probes fgetc past the first EOF return as part of peek/termination handling. fgetc returning EOF again on an EOF-flagged stream is defined, harmless behavior.
suppressions.reproducer: uv run python tools/native_checks.py --kind analyzer --build native/build; unix.Stream 'Read function called when stream is in EOF state' at native/src/viz/plot.cpp:71:38 and 73:39
suppressions.remove_when: Remove when CSA no longer emits the EOF-state read diagnostic for the fgetc calls in the plot.cpp CSV reader.
